description: This file defines a Java class 'AssetFragment' that extends Android's Fragment class. It is responsible for displaying an image asset received from a paired device, typically used within an Android application for wearable devices. The class manages inflating its layout, initializing an ImageView, and setting a bitmap image on it.

classes.name: AssetFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment for displaying a photo asset received from a paired device.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and initializes the ImageView component.

methods.name: setBackgroundImage
methods.description: Sets a Bitmap as the image for the ImageView to display.
